name: dotnet-msix. Package .NET desktop apps from csproj (`WindowsPackageType`) or WAP; sign, distribute via Store/App Installer/enterprise (SCCM/Intune), configure auto-updates and multi-architecture `.msixbundle`; CI/CD. Assumptions: Windows App SDK 1.6+, .NET 8.0+, Windows 10 build 19041+ (MSIX); build 1709+ (App Installer auto-update). WinUI: [skill:dotnet-winui]; AOT: [skill:dotnet-native-aot]; CI/CD: [skill:dotnet-gha-patterns], [skill:dotnet-ado-patterns]; NuGet: [skill:dotnet-nuget-authoring]; containers: [skill:dotnet-containers].

Modern WinUI 3 can package directly from `.csproj`; WPF/WinForms use VS-template `.wapproj` referencing the app project. Manifest defines identity, capabilities, assets.

All MSIX packages must be signed to install on Windows. The signing certificate's Subject must match the `Publisher` attribute in the package manifest.

Development: self-signed;
